Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Performance & Device Compatibility Upgrade:
   - 90Hz / 120Hz High-Refresh Screen Unlock while browsing + automatic step-down
     during fullscreen video playback to save battery and prevent heat.
   - Built-in Encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 & Google 8.8.8.8) ISP
     Unblocker: automatically bypasses carrier DNS blocks (Jio, Airtel, VI, campus
     Wi-Fi) with no VPN needed, plus retry-on-timeout/poison protection.
   - 8-Worker HTTP/2 Connection Pool + 90s AniList Metadata Cache + 12 MB Poster
     RAM Cache (RGB_565): much faster Home, Search, Browse, and Episode loading.
   - Hardware + Automatic Software Video Decoder Fallback (ExoPlayer Media3) so
     tricky HEVC/AVC streams play instead of showing a black screen on budget chips.
   - Low-RAM WebView Crash Shield (onRenderProcessGone) so heavy third-party video
     embeds cannot force-close the whole app on 3-4 GB RAM phones.
   - Offscreen Scroll Virtualization (content-visibility: auto), Auto Lite-GPU Mode
     on low-RAM phones & TVs, Instant Startup toggle, and 1-Tap Temp Cache Cleaner
     inside Settings -> Performance & compatibility.
   - Full Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV Stick (Leanback Launcher + TV Banner +
     auto Desktop/DPAD mode on TVs) and Foldable / Split-Screen continuity.

2. Hardened Multi-Layer Player Popup & In-Page-Push Ad Blocker:
   - Blocks Adsterra Social Bar, ExoClick In-Page Push, Monetag, Galaksion, AdCash,
     AdSpyglass, Clickadu, HilltopAds, and floating Ad-badged banners across Light
     DOM, open/closed Shadow DOM, and banner iframes.

3. Android 15 (targetSdk 35) Edge-to-Edge Status Bar & Gesture Bar Window Fix:
   - Applies native WindowInsetsCompat safe-area padding so the Kuro header never
     overlaps system clock/network/battery icons, while keeping true fullscreen video.

4. Unified Account, Trackers & Discord Rich Presence Hub + 24 Manga PFPs/Banners:
   - Kuro Cloud Account card, AniList & MAL 2-Way Sync, Discord Rich Presence hub,
     and 24 real manga face PFPs + matching 16:9 banners (art-11 .. art-34).
